text: {"strategy":{"name":"per-record","summary":"For each order: read order detail, search CRM by email, search tickets by order ID, decide and apply order/ticket fixes. Then a batch phase puts customers with 2+ refunded orders on hold unless VIP.","rationale":"Simple per-record reads via detail pages and exact searches; batch rule handled in a dependent foreach over computed customer IDs."},"phases":[{"id":"per_order","kind":"foreach","over":"$input.records","key":"$rec.orderId","dependsOn":[],"steps":[{"id":"goto_order","op":"goto","app":"Orders","url":"/orders/{$rec.orderId}"},{"id":"read_order","op":"extract","fields":[{"name":"orderId","control":"orders.orders_id.order_order_id_fact","parse":"string"},{"name":"status","control":"orders.orders_id.order_status_fact","parse":"string"},{"name":"customerId","control":"orders.orders_id.customer_customer_id_fact","parse":"string"},{"name":"email","control":"orders.orders_id.customer_customer_email_fact","parse":"string"},{"name":"reviewFlag","control":"orders.orders_id.review_review_flag_fact","parse":"string"},{"name":"reviewReason","control":"orders.orders_id.review_review_reason_fact","parse":"string"}]},{"id":"goto_crm_search","op":"goto","app":"CRM","url":"/customers?q={encode($out.read_order.email)}"},{"id":"crm_rows","op":"extractTable","table":"crm.customers.customer_id_name_table","columns":[{"name":"customerId","header":"CUSTOMER ID"},{"name":"email","header":"EMAIL"},{"name":"status","header":"STATUS"}],"key":"customerId"},{"id":"goto_tickets","op":"goto","app":"Support","url":"/tickets?q={encode($rec.orderId)}"},{"id":"ticket_rows","op":"extractTable","table":"support.tickets.ticket_order_table","columns":[{"name":"ticketId","header":"TICKET"},{"name":"orderId","header":"ORDER"},{"name":"category","header":"CATEGORY"},{"name":"status","header":"STATUS"},{"name":"owner","header":"OWNER"}],"key":"ticketId"},{"id":"decide","op":"compute","assign":[{"name":"matches","expr":"filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email)"},{"name":"matchCount","expr":"len(filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email))"},{"name":"matchedId","expr":"if(len(filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email)) == 1, get(first(filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email)), 'customerId'), null)"},{"name":"orderStatus","expr":"lower($out.read_order.status)"},{"name":"changeCustomer","expr":"len(filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email)) == 1 && get(first(filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email)), 'customerId') != $out.read_order.customerId"},{"name":"flagReason","expr":"if(len(filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email)) > 1, 'Duplicate customer', if(len(filterBy($out.crm_rows.rows, 'email', '==', $out.read_order.email)) == 0, 'Unknown customer', null))"},{"name":"ticket","expr":"lookup($out.ticket_rows.rows, 'orderId', $rec.orderId)"},{"name":"ticketId","expr":"get(lookup($out.ticket_rows.rows, 'orderId', $rec.orderId), 'ticketId')"},{"name":"tCat","expr":"lower(get(lookup($out.ticket_rows.rows, 'orderId', $rec.orderId), 'category'))"},{"name":"tStatus","expr":"lower(get(lookup($out.ticket_rows.rows, 'orderId', $rec.orderId), 'status'))"},{"name":"tOwner","expr":"get(lookup($out.ticket_rows.rows, 'orderId', $rec.orderId), 'owner')"}]},{"id":"decide2","op":"compute","assign":[{"name":"needFlag","expr":"$out.decide.flagReason != null && !(lower($out.read_order.reviewFlag) == 'yes' && $out.read_order.reviewReason == $out.decide.flagReason)"},{"name":"orderEdit","expr":"$out.decide.changeCustomer || ($out.decide.flagReason != null && !(lower($out.read_order.reviewFlag) == 'yes' && $out.read_order.reviewReason == $out.decide.flagReason))"},{"name":"hasTicket","expr":"$out.decide.ticketId != null"},{"name":"refundFix","expr":"$out.decide.ticketId != null && $out.decide.orderStatus == 'refunded' && ($out.decide.tCat != 'refund' || $out.decide.tStatus != 'resolved')"},{"name":"deliveredFix","expr":"$out.decide.ticketId != null && $out.decide.orderStatus != 'refunded' && $out.decide.orderStatus == 'delivered' && $out.decide.tCat == 'shipping' && ($out.decide.tStatus == 'open' || $out.decide.tStatus == 'pending')"},{"name":"damageFix","expr":"$out.decide.ticketId != null && $out.decide.orderStatus != 'refunded' && !($out.decide.orderStatus == 'delivered' && $out.decide.tCat == 'shipping' && ($out.decide.tStatus == 'open' || $out.decide.tStatus == 'pending')) && $out.decide.tCat == 'damage' && $out.decide.tStatus != 'escalated'"},{"name":"refundNote","expr":"concat('Reconciled: refund confirmed for ', $rec.orderId)"},{"name":"deliveredNote","expr":"concat('Reconciled: delivered ', $rec.orderId)"}]},{"id":"goto_order_edit","when":"$out.decide2.orderEdit","op":"goto","app":"Orders","url":"/orders/{$rec.orderId}/edit"},{"id":"fill_customer","when":"$out.decide2.orderEdit && $out.decide.changeCustomer","op":"fill","control":"orders.orders_id_edit.customer_id","value":"$out.decide.matchedId"},{"id":"fill_flag","when":"$out.decide2.orderEdit && $out.decide2.needFlag","op":"fill","control":"orders.orders_id_edit.flag_for_review","value":"'true'"},{"id":"fill_reason","when":"$out.decide2.orderEdit && $out.decide2.needFlag","op":"fill","control":"orders.orders_id_edit.review_reason","value":"$out.decide.flagReason"},{"id":"submit_order","when":"$out.decide2.orderEdit","op":"submit","control":"orders.orders_id_edit.update_order_button","writes":["app:orders:order:{$rec.orderId}"],"guards":[{"control":"orders.orders_id_edit.customer_id","equals":"$out.read_order.customerId"}],"verify":{"url":"/orders/{$rec.orderId}","fields":[{"name":"customerId","control":"orders.orders_id.customer_customer_id_fact","equals":"if($out.decide.changeCustomer, $out.decide.matchedId, $out.read_order.customerId)"},{"name":"reviewFlag","control":"orders.orders_id.review_review_flag_fact","equals":"if($out.decide2.needFlag, 'Yes', $out.read_order.reviewFlag)"},{"name":"reviewReason","control":"orders.orders_id.review_review_reason_fact","equals":"if($out.decide2.needFlag, $out.decide.flagReason, $out.read_order.reviewReason)"}]},"irreversible":false},{"id":"goto_ticket_edit_refund","when":"$out.decide2.refundFix","op":"goto","app":"Support","url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}/edit"},{"id":"sel_cat_refund","when":"$out.decide2.refundFix","op":"select","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.category","value":"'refund'"},{"id":"sel_status_refund","when":"$out.decide2.refundFix","op":"select","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.status","value":"'resolved'"},{"id":"submit_ticket_refund","when":"$out.decide2.refundFix","op":"submit","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.save_ticket_button","writes":["app:support:ticket:{$out.decide.ticketId}"],"guards":[{"control":"support.tickets_id_edit.category","equals":"$out.decide.tCat"},{"control":"support.tickets_id_edit.status","equals":"$out.decide.tStatus"}],"verify":{"url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}","fields":[{"name":"category","control":"support.tickets_id.ticket_details_category_fact","equals":"'Refund'"},{"name":"status","control":"support.tickets_id.ticket_details_status_fact","equals":"'Resolved'"}]},"irreversible":false},{"id":"goto_ticket_note_refund","when":"$out.decide2.refundFix","after":["submit_ticket_refund"],"op":"goto","app":"Support","url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}"},{"id":"fill_note_refund","when":"$out.decide2.refundFix","op":"fill","control":"support.tickets_id.note","value":"$out.decide2.refundNote"},{"id":"submit_note_refund","when":"$out.decide2.refundFix","op":"submit","control":"support.tickets_id.add_note_button","writes":["app:support:ticket:{$out.decide.ticketId}:notes"],"guards":[],"verify":{"url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}","fields":[{"name":"status","control":"support.tickets_id.ticket_details_status_fact","equals":"'Resolved'"}]},"irreversible":false},{"id":"goto_ticket_edit_deliv","when":"$out.decide2.deliveredFix","op":"goto","app":"Support","url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}/edit"},{"id":"sel_status_deliv","when":"$out.decide2.deliveredFix","op":"select","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.status","value":"'resolved'"},{"id":"submit_ticket_deliv","when":"$out.decide2.deliveredFix","op":"submit","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.save_ticket_button","writes":["app:support:ticket:{$out.decide.ticketId}"],"guards":[{"control":"support.tickets_id_edit.status","equals":"$out.decide.tStatus"}],"verify":{"url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}","fields":[{"name":"status","control":"support.tickets_id.ticket_details_status_fact","equals":"'Resolved'"}]},"irreversible":false},{"id":"goto_ticket_note_deliv","when":"$out.decide2.deliveredFix","after":["submit_ticket_deliv"],"op":"goto","app":"Support","url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}"},{"id":"fill_note_deliv","when":"$out.decide2.deliveredFix","op":"fill","control":"support.tickets_id.note","value":"$out.decide2.deliveredNote"},{"id":"submit_note_deliv","when":"$out.decide2.deliveredFix","op":"submit","control":"support.tickets_id.add_note_button","writes":["app:support:ticket:{$out.decide.ticketId}:notes"],"guards":[],"verify":{"url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}","fields":[{"name":"status","control":"support.tickets_id.ticket_details_status_fact","equals":"'Resolved'"}]},"irreversible":false},{"id":"goto_ticket_edit_dmg","when":"$out.decide2.damageFix","op":"goto","app":"Support","url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}/edit"},{"id":"sel_status_dmg","when":"$out.decide2.damageFix","op":"select","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.status","value":"'escalated'"},{"id":"sel_owner_dmg","when":"$out.decide2.damageFix","op":"select","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.owner","value":"'Tier 2'"},{"id":"submit_ticket_dmg","when":"$out.decide2.damageFix","op":"submit","control":"support.tickets_id_edit.save_ticket_button","writes":["app:support:ticket:{$out.decide.ticketId}"],"guards":[{"control":"support.tickets_id_edit.status","equals":"$out.decide.tStatus"},{"control":"support.tickets_id_edit.owner","equals":"$out.decide.tOwner"}],"verify":{"url":"/tickets/{$out.decide.ticketId}","fields":[{"name":"status","control":"support.tickets_id.ticket_details_status_fact","equals":"'Escalated'"},{"name":"owner","control":"support.tickets_id.ticket_details_owner_fact","equals":"'Tier 2'"}]},"irreversible":false}]},{"id":"holds","kind":"foreach","over":"filterBy(entries(countBy(filterBy(filterBy(pluck($phase.per_order, 'out.decide'), 'orderStatus', '==', 'refunded'), 'matchedId', '!=', null), 'matchedId')), 'value', '>=', 2)","key":"$rec.key","dependsOn":["per_order"],"steps":[{"id":"goto_cust","op":"goto","app":"CRM","url":"/customers/{$rec.key}"},{"id":"read_cust","op":"extract","fields":[{"name":"status","control":"crm.customers_id.profile_status_fact","parse":"string"}]},{"id":"decide_hold","op":"compute","assign":[{"name":"needHold","expr":"lower($out.read_cust.status) != 'vip' && lower($out.read_cust.status) != 'on hold'"}]},{"id":"goto_cust_edit","when":"$out.decide_hold.needHold","op":"goto","app":"CRM","url":"/customers/{$rec.key}/edit"},{"id":"sel_hold","when":"$out.decide_hold.needHold","op":"select","control":"crm.customers_id_edit.status","value":"'on_hold'"},{"id":"submit_hold","when":"$out.decide_hold.needHold","op":"submit","control":"crm.customers_id_edit.save_changes_button","writes":["app:crm:customer:{$rec.key}"],"guards":[{"control":"crm.customers_id_edit.status","equals":"lower($out.read_cust.status)"}],"verify":{"url":"/customers/{$rec.key}","fields":[{"name":"status","control":"crm.customers_id.profile_status_fact","equals":"'On hold'"}]},"irreversible":false}]}],"outcomes":[{"id":"customer_ids","description":"Orders with exactly one CRM email match point to that customer ID."},{"id":"review_flags","description":"Orders with duplicate or unknown customers are flagged with the correct reason."},{"id":"tickets","description":"Tickets are corrected per refund/delivered/damage rules, with the notes required by those rules."},{"id":"holds","description":"Non-VIP matched customers with 2+ refunded orders in the list are on_hold."}],"assumptions":["CRM search by email returns all customers with that email; exact email equality is applied afterward.","Ticket search by order ID returns that order's ticket; at most one exists.","Status facts show labels such as 'On hold' and 'VIP'; the CRM edit select values are the lowercase forms."],"risks":["Customer email case differences would make the exact match miss.","The 'Review reason' fact may display '—' when empty.","Add-note verification only checks ticket status, not the note text."]}
